name: meeting-notes
description: Local macOS meeting recorder and structured Markdown notes plugin: dual-track system audio + microphone capture (Zoom, Meet, Teams, Feishu, browsers), background recording across sessions, one-click local Swift setup, bilingual EN/中文 UI, and resumable AI transcription.
suggestedPrompts: Open the Meeting Notes side pane and start recording a meeting
Transcribe my most recent meeting and generate structured notes with action items
Search past meeting notes and transcripts for budget or architecture decisions
